# Disallow parallel encoding<AvailableFrom v="3.2.29" />

Disallows the renderer from doing rendering frames and encoding at the same time. This makes the rendering process more memory-efficient, but possibly slower.

## CLI flag

```text
--disallow-parallel-encoding
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)
- [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#disallowparallelencoding)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setDisallowParallelEncoding(true);
```
